QuestInfo.name: [Legends] Maple World Air Quality
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a favor to ask of you...
QuestInfo.1: You can check Maple World's air pollution level by staying logged in for 30 minutes with the Carbon Dioxide Detector which Cassandra gave you.
QuestInfo.2: You must lead Maple World to a cleaner future!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP based on level per 1 Legends Awards Coin (Up to 3 Coins/Day)

0.0: #b#h0##k! Can't you feel it? The air is getting polluted, the weather is getting strange... We gotta do something, before our lovely Maple World is ruined! Can you help me?

yes.0: Great, let's get started! We need to find out what the current carbon dioxide level is in the air. I don't actually know what carbon dioxide is, but someone told me it smells bad, so it MUST be what's causing the air pollution! Anyway, I gave you a Carbon Dioxide Detector to measure how much of it is in the air.\n\n#bStay logged in for 30 minutes with the Carbon Dioxide Detector in your Set-up inventory tab#k to get a good reading. Once the red light on it starts blinking, bring the detector back to me by clicking on the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen. That should do it! Good luck.

no.0: You really don't care? Do you want to see this world turn into a filthy mess? Talk to me again when you come to your senses.

item.0: This detector is not done detecting. Let it detect more!
